The dossier conflict PARTIAL_END_CANDIDATE_ON_YES_ORDER ('supersession 2023-05-30') traces to FR Doc. 2023-11488 (88 FR 34443), an OFAC rule publishing General License 1C, which supersedes an earlier OFAC general license and not EO 14078; it is a false lead and would be resolved as such.

Most of the 30 inventory clauses are dated agency directives inserted into EO 14144 (for example 'By August 1, 2025', 'By September 2, 2025', 'By November 1, 2025', 'By December 1, 2025', and 'Within 1 year' / 'Within 3 years of the date of this order') or strike-and-insert amendments of EO 14144 and EO 13694. For each directive a deadline is not proof of performance, and the dossier holds no source showing whether or when the Commerce, Homeland Security, Defense, OMB or FAR Council actions were performed; the dossier also holds no later order or current-law record (the USC search recorded one hit, the eCFR search none, and the dossier has no CURRENT record) showing which inserted EO 14144 provisions remain in force on 2026-10-14. Needed: the held text of the agency performance records or current EO 14144 as amended, per directive.

The only held record of the emergency chain that EO 13694 (amended by section 3) depends on is ACTOR_TEXT:FRDOC:2026-06076, the notice of March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15511), registered at jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts/fr-2026-06076.txt, a path not materialized in this working tree, so it cannot be cited; the earlier annual notices for the EO 13694 emergency since 2015 are not evidence records for this order.

The dossier conflict PARTIAL_END_CANDIDATE_ON_YES_ORDER ('revocation 2026-03-24') traces to the Notice of March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15511), a continuation notice, not a revocation; it is a false lead, but the order cannot be submitted on the other gaps.

Proclamation 2578 of March 15, 1943 (Jackson Hole National Monument), which the Federal Register executive-order catalog lists as superseding EO 7680 in part (jobs/later-events/output/CATALOG_INDEX.csv, row EO:7680), is not held as text; the dossier names it only as 'Acting identity absent from census: PROC:2578'. Which lands of the 1937 enlargement it removed from the Elk Refuge, and when, cannot be read.

No current land-status or statutory source is held for the lands the order reserved (19,939.78 acres in Teton County, Wyoming): the current-law USC and eCFR searches recorded no hit for the order, so no CURRENT record shows the reservation in force on 2026-10-14. Needed: current BLM land records or Public Land Orders for the withdrawal, or the text of the statutes governing the National Elk Refuge.

Executive Order 9021 of January 12, 1942 (held text) modified EO 7680 'to the extent necessary to permit the leasing' of 880 acres for an airport; its effect on the 1937 reservation is a partial later event whose present status is also undetermined.

Executive Order 12608 of September 9, 1987 (52 FR 34617) is held at jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_12608.txt, and the 1989 OFR codification (jobs/ofr-codification-1989/output/texts/EO_9873.txt) records 'Para. 2 amended by EO 12608', replacing the Bureau of the Budget with the Office of Management and Budget in paragraph 2. EO 12608 is not an evidence record in this packet's dossier for EO 9873 (its evidence holds only the original, the two clauses and one CURRENT record), so the amendment cannot be listed as a later event and a YES claim would omit a known amendment.

The only held current-law record is CURRENT:EO:9873#0, the Ex. Ord. No. 9873 note under 36 U.S.C. 2111, which reproduces the 1947 text and says the 1923 Act section is 'now subsec. (b) of this section'. It does not state present force, and the text of 36 U.S.C. 2111(b) and of the Commission's present administration of the Mexico City National Cemetery is not held, so a current predicate for the 1947 transfer of functions as of 2026-10-14 cannot be established from held sources.
